This is a benchmark replay interface, not a live cluster or a Kubernetes-compatible API. Start with GET /v1/catalog. Use curl -sG "$NATIVE_API_URL/v1/resources" --data-urlencode 'q=checkout'. Endpoints: /v1/resources, /v1/events, /v1/logs, /v1/traces, /v1/topology. Filters: entity_id (exact), start/end (inclusive observed_at, RFC3339 with timezone), signal (exact), trace_id (exact), record_ref (exact), q (case-insensitive text), limit (1..200, default 50), offset (default 0). Responses have items, total and next_offset. Follow next_offset until null; a first page is not all evidence. The API returns source records and does not infer anomalies, causal relationships, or entity aliases. Apply the task scope/window and assemble evidence yourself. Metric values are available ONLY via real PromQL at $PROMETHEUS_URL/api/v1/query and /api/v1/query_range. Discover series through GET /v1/metrics/index with the same filters; this value-free index provides prometheus_metric_name, prometheus_labels, record_ref, observed_at, original stat, unit and provenance. Use curl -sG "$PROMETHEUS_URL/api/v1/query" --data-urlencode 'query=METRIC{entity_id="ID"}' --data-urlencode 'time=ORIGINAL_OBSERVED_AT'. Source dimensions use collision-free dim_ labels; dimension_label_map in the index maps original dimension names to these Prometheus labels. Use the returned metric_unit and source_stat labels. Metrics with __recorded_STAT suffix are retained recorded aggregates, NOT reconstructed raw samples. Do not treat avg/latest as counters. Prometheus uses evaluation timestamps and lookback; inspect timestamp(METRIC) or query at the indexed original sample time to retain source timing. Match metric name, labels and source time to the index when citing record_ref. Never infer evidence IDs from their contents. Non-metric APIs return record_ref directly. No raw scene files are mounted in the agent container. Public answer-schema.json and task contracts remain under /scene. Do not read /tests; those are verifier-only. Write your answer to /logs/agent/answer.json. Non-finite source fields are returned as string tokens with source_value_encoding listing exact paths and original tokens. These are source anomalies, not valid span/trace identifiers. No identifier is reconstructed. For submillisecond samples use prometheus_sample_time from the index for PromQL; original observed_at is preserved in the index and source_observed_at label.
